issues.issue: Did the Officer misunderstand central facts about the arrest warrants and how warrants are issued in Iraq?
issues.applicant_position: Officer conflated two arrest warrants and misconstrued country documents on how warrants are issued in Iraq.
issues.respondent_position: Officer understood all allegations; any warrant error was immaterial; reading of country evidence was open to the Officer.
issues.result_quote: Mr. Abdullah has not established an error in the Officer’s interpretation of country condition documentation

issues.issue: Did the Officer fail to justify its finding that letters from friends, a co-worker, a brother and the Major General have little probative value?
issues.applicant_position: Low probative value was in effect an unexplained credibility finding; letters were not vague, and the Major General letter was wrongly discounted.
issues.respondent_position: No credibility finding was made; Officer found insufficient evidence of a s. 97 risk, and the letters lacked detail of the charges.
